body.label: Effect
body.html: A Sprite distracts one creature within 4 units. On a success, make it Exposed.

surges.html: Increase this Action's range by 2 units.
Reduce the Full Manifestation dice threshold by 1. This Surge may be used only once.

rider.title: SPRITE — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 3 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 1 additional Mana to fully manifest your Sprite.
